description: Three-column dashboard with the Positive Mental Attitude guide open: dispute shown both ways, missable warning, Next Up queue and sources rail. Progress seeded (12 earned, 5 of 18 meditation spots ticked).
Platinum roadmap view: five phases with per-phase trophy progress, from Chapter 1 setup to the 100% grind.
Missables view: risk tiers — High (1 truly missable), Watch (2 time-sensitive or easy to half-finish), Safe (52 earn any time).
Sources bibliography: official-list sources and per-trophy guide sources with read dates and reuse counts; the audit strip is visible at the top.
